message.content:
**Uno – Quick Overview** | What | How it works | |------|--------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever you agree on). Points are earned by winning rounds and are tallied from the cards left in opponents’ hands. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the Uno deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face‑down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card (e.g., Draw Two, Wild), treat it as if it had been played by the dealer. | | **Turn order** | Clockwise (unless a Reverse card changes direction). | | **Playing a card** | On your turn you may play one card that matches either the **color** or the **number/symbol** of the top card on the discard pile. You may also play a **Wild** card at any time. | | **Special cards** | • **Draw Two (+2)** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction.
• **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Wild** – Player chooses the next color.
• **Wild Draw Four (+4)** – Same as Wild, but next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if you have no other playable card; otherwise you risk being challenged.) | | **Drawing** | If you cannot play a card, you must draw one from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may immediately play it; otherwise your turn ends. | | **Calling “Uno”** | When you have **exactly one card left**, you must say “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a round** | The first player to get rid of all their cards wins the round. | | **Scoring** | Add up the point values of the cards still held by the other players:
• Number cards = face value.
• Draw Two, Reverse, Skip = 20 points each.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 points each.
Points are added to the winner’s total. | | **Game end** | Play continues until someone reaches the agreed‑upon score (commonly 500). | **Optional house rules** - *Stacking*: Allow players to stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards instead of drawing. - *No “draw‑four challenge”*: Simplify by allowing Wild Draw Four to be played anytime. - *“Uno” penalty*: Instead of drawing two cards, the player who forgot to call UNO must draw a single card. Enjoy!
